description: Generates (or returns the cached) AI summary of the incident — a short human-readable explanation of what happened and why, based on diagnostics. Idempotent: repeated calls return the same summary. Requires `network_diagnostics_enabled` on the plan.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: incident_generate_ai_summary
title: Generate AI summary for incident
